saw_lines: People buy an electric toothbrush once and judge it every morning, so the first week decides if they stay.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before buyers reach any offer or proof.
Your 14 of 23 copy ads open on the same mijn tanden voelen nog nooit line, so name two new angles from your product and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 14 of 23 copy ads open on the same “mijn tanden voelen nog nooit” line, so most of the account tells one story. Name two new angles from your product, like charging three times a year, and test each against it.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 23 ads, so a viewer who sees two of them gets nothing new. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and creative in each of the 7 ads so every one reads fresh.

None of your 26 live ads shows a proof number, so new buyers have nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead two ads with it on the creative.
0 of 23 copy ads carry an offer, so a buyer ready today has no reason to click now. Build three new ads with free, fast delivery in the first line and close with a 60 day test on the creative.

ads_1: Three new hooks on charging and whitening, each with free delivery in line one
